# GlobalHorizontalIrradianceFromClearsky（seed 1）

## 背景

This series contains Global Horizontal Irradiance for a location in Oaxaca, Mexico.
The Global Horizontal Irradiance is the total amount of sun energy (in Watts per squared meter) arriving on a horizontal surface.
